verdict.rationale: Superset documents an official MCP server that lets another agent or script create workspaces, launch agents, open terminals, schedule automations and manage tasks. A runtime probe confirmed the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint at api.superset.sh/mcp is live and enforces the MCP OAuth flow. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of actually connecting an agent and using the MCP tools beyond the authentication handshake.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Orchestrate agent work programmatically: create workspaces, launch agents with a prompt, open terminals, and track tasks from another agent or script via the Superset MCP server.
Superset MCP server: create Git-worktree workspaces, launch coding-agent sessions, schedule automations, open terminals, and manage tasks on behalf of a Superset user.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.superset.sh/mcp-server
the documented remote MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP; tools for tasks, workspaces, agents, automations, terminals, hosts, projects) is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow.
